title: Arm & Hammer Baking Soda vs Great Value Baking Soda

brand.product: ARM & HAMMER Pure Baking Soda, 3 lb Resealable Bag

summary: Both are single-ingredient sodium bicarbonate, so the same price buys a 4 lb bag of Great Value instead of a 3 lb bag of Arm & Hammer.
evidence: Walmart's Arm & Hammer listing describes it as '100% Pure Sodium Bicarbonate Powder'. Walmart's Great Value listing says it is 'Made with sodium bicarbonate for a simple, single-ingredient formula'. Walmart prices: 7.1 cents/oz vs 5.3 cents/oz.
differences: We could not read either ingredient panel directly (Walmart's ingredient sections were blank), so the match rests on the retailer descriptions. That is why it is marked medium. The savings are small in dollars. At the 1 lb size, Arm & Hammer was $1.52 and Great Value $1.00.
